policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Bangladesh advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bulgaria's current Foreign Ministry guidance says Bulgarian citizens need a visa issued in advance to travel to Bangladesh.
conditions: Applies to a Bulgarian ordinary passport holder making a short visitor trip to Bangladesh.
The visa must be issued before travel; the guidance directs travellers to contact a Bangladesh diplomatic mission.
The guidance also requires passport space for the entry visa to be affixed.
Work, residence, transit, special passports, Bangladeshi-origin documents and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Bangladesh tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Argentina's current Embassy guidance says Argentine citizens may obtain Bangladesh's visa on arrival for qualifying short tourist or business stays.
conditions: Applies to an Argentine ordinary passport holder visiting for tourism or business for up to 30 days.
Visa issuance is at a Bangladesh international airport, including Dhaka; carry a passport valid at least six months, return ticket and hotel reservation.
The route is not visa-free: issuance and admission depend on the local immigration authorities' decision.
The notice says online visa processing is not available to Argentine citizens; work, residence, transit and special passports are outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Bulgaria's current Foreign Ministry guidance expressly requires a visa issued in advance for Bulgarian citizens travelling to Bangladesh; the fallback's visa-on-arrival status is incorrect.
